task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First of all, you could, like, travel south. And then, attempt to go to the west. After that, venture west. With that accomplished, travel north. With that done, move north. And then, make an attempt to travel east. And then, venture south. With that done, pick up the loaf of bread from the floor of the sauna. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You've stumbled into a normal room. Your mind races to think of what kind of room would be normal. And then it hits you. Of course. You're in the office. You begin to take stock of what's here.

You can make out an armchair. The armchair is normal. The armchair appears to be empty.

There is an open door leading south. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
